subject.title: [Feature]: Channels settings page should always show built-in channels alongside custom channels

question: Should maintainers adopt and refresh the open cross-repository PR for this issue, or ask for a fresh same-repository replacement?
rationale: The issue remains valid and narrowly fixable, but an open linked PR already contains the candidate resolver/test change and blocks safe duplicate automation.

options.title: Review or adopt the linked PR
options.body: Use the existing focused patch if maintainers can refresh proof, reconcile current path drift, and bring the branch through normal review.

options.title: Request a fresh replacement
options.body: Close or set aside the stale fork PR and ask for a current-main UI-only resolver PR with focused source and browser proof.

recommendation.title: Review or adopt the linked PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing focused patch if maintainers can refresh proof, reconcile current path drift, and bring the branch through normal review.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision is closest to the channel UI metadata/catalog path and the choice of adopting or replacing the fork patch.
